texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Moshe Gil, Documents of the Jewish Pious Foundations from the Cairo Geniza (Leiden: Brill, 1976).
texts.html:
1. Record of the sum of the repairs
  2. made in the large ṭabaqa,
  3. Shirkat al-Dayyān R. Menashē, may God preserve him, (being)
  4. the apartment of his son, al-Shaykh Joseph:
  5. The first day, that is, Thursday, 15
  6. Iyyar: Clay, 2. Gypsum, 2.
  7. Gypsum, 12¼ ⅓. A layer of clay pipes, ¾.
  8. A meal, 1¼. Helpers, 2¼. A special mason, 2¼
  9. Supervision, 1. A water carrier, 1½.
  10. Friday ….
  11. Gypsum, 6. Water, 2. A meal, 1¼, A special mason, 5.
  12. Helpers, 4½. Pillars, 1. A layer of clay pipes, ¼.
  13. A carpenter, ¾. Sunday:
  14. Gypsum, 9. A gift, ¼ + ⅓. 2 special masons, 4.
  15. Helpers, 5. A water carrier, 1½. Clay, 1. A meal, 1¼.
  16. Total, 68¼.
  17. Monday, the following day, sawyers, 11.
  18. …. Nāshūsh and transportation, 16½.
  19. …. Tuesday,
  20. …. a carpenter, 4. A helper, 2½.
